literal_meaning: চলা এবং আসা (movement or going and coming)
figurative_meaning_en: circulation or operation (e.g., of blood or traffic)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার শরীরে রক্তের চলাচল ঠিক নেই।
শহরে যানজটের কারণে চলাচল স্থগিত হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There is no proper blood circulation in his body.
Movement has come to a halt in the city due to traffic jam.
note: Commonly used in contexts of bodily functions or traffic flow in Bengali everyday language.
